en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a long row of solid brick institutional buildings with three to four stories, built in a late‑19th‑century style with gabled roofs, chimneys, and light stone banding around the windows and corners. The complex is enclosed by a brick wall topped with metal railings, bordering a wide unpaved or lightly paved road lined with a few young trees. No people or vehicles are visible. There is no printed caption or legible signage on the image.
